title: Nutty Flaky Korean Squash Bao
description: A kid-friendly Korean dish featuring poached squash, crispy bao, and a nutty crunch. This dish is perfect for a warm evening meal or a snack.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine all-purpose flour, bread flour, granulated sugar, and salt.
Add active dry yeast and mix well.
Gradually add warm water and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Cut out round shapes using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place the bao on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving 1 inch (2.5 cm) space between each bao.
Brush the tops with corn oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown.
Meanwhile, poach the kabocha squash cubes in boiling water for 10-15 minutes until tender.
Drain the squash and mix with gochujang, roasted peanuts, and chopped scallions.
Split the bao in half, fill with the squash mixture, and serve immediately.
